content: {"praised":["Strong character development beyond Anakin’s arc.","Focus on story and character over special effects.","Adventure, action, and witty dialogue enhance the saga.","Animation quality makes the universe more believable.","New Padawan adds depth, not just comic relief."],"criticized":["Plot thin, lacks depth and complexity.","CGI animation feels cheap compared to original series.","Poor connection to main Star Wars films.","Short, simple, aimed only at kids.","Repeats mistakes from earlier Star Wars releases."]}
